headline: Senate dominates the scoreboard with college sports legislation, as Protect College Sports Act clears 77-22!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed the Protect College Sports Act (S. 4668) by a vote of 77-22, protecting student-athlete name, image, and likeness rights while regulating conference mergers. The chamber also passed eight additional bills including food safety, counterterrorism insurance reauthorization, and ALS therapy access improvements, honored former Senator Nancy Kassebaum with a resolution, and set up cloture votes on two pending measures for later in the week.

onTheFloor.title: Protect College Sports Act - safeguard student-athlete NIL rights and regulate intercollegiate athletics competition
Common Cents Act - end penny minting and round cash transactions to nearest 5 cents
Children's Health Protection Act - reauthorize Young Women's Breast Health Education program
Accelerating Access to Critical Therapies for ALS Reauthorization Act - extend ALS therapy provisions through 2031
Falun Gong and Victims of Forced Organ Harvesting Protection Act - impose sanctions on China for forced organ harvesting
Making America's Food Safer Act - strengthen food safety regulations under FDA
Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act - extend terrorism risk coverage for 2002 act
Stop Insider Trading Act - restrict stock trading by members of Congress and their families
